layers.text: Style: bold chibi pixel art for a playful turn-based strategy board game, a board game come to life: chunky simple shapes, flat colours with one shadow tone, low detail, clean readable silhouette that reads at a glance at small size, slightly silly and cheerful.

Camera: consistent strategy-game camera, three-quarter view looking slightly down, the subject faces down and to the right (south-east), whole subject visible and centred on a transparent background, nothing cropped. The subject stands directly on the empty transparent background: nothing at all is drawn under it.

Light: the sun is low in the south-west, at the bottom left of the image: faces turned to the left or to the viewer are lit, faces turned to the right are in shadow, snow is brightest on its left side, and nothing is lit from the right.

Class: one single building or improvement map piece with a unique chunky silhouette, thick single-colour black outline, big simple shapes. It stands directly on the empty transparent background with no ground, soil, grass or platform under it; the bottom of the building is the lowest thing in the image.

Subject: a big prehistoric Lost World tribal town filling the width of the image: a curved palisade of sharpened tawny logs across the front, in its middle a gate made of a giant cream dinosaur skull whose open jaws are the entrance, behind it five round huts with tawny thatch roofs and hide walls with big dark brown spots, one big longhouse at the back, a few dark basalt stones, and three tall cream bone totems with bright red-orange paint as the only accent. Buildings only.
